page.layout: One printed page. Full-width heading block at top (italic line, large capitals title, roman and italic lines). Below it one column of running text with a large woodcut initial S at left. Catchword/signature line at foot: "E 2" and "Ocr" (the latter a running signature fragment). Page number at top right.

main_text.l: simulac audivi tuam M. omnium Ordinum
Regem creatum esse. Auxit hoc meum
tuis, inter quas, tanquam hesperus inter
sydera, lucet maximè pietas tua, quam
edita scripta testantur. Pietas dico non ficta
& imperita, sed vera & erudita, quæ zelum
quas qui ignorat, etiam Deum ignorat.

page.notes: The woodcut initial S is a decorative letter, transcribed as "S" joined to "ERENISSIME" as printed. The "Ocr" catchword is partly cut off at the edge and uncertain. Small specks and the digitiser's watermark are omitted.
